answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a Sybil resistance mechanism known as Proof of Physical Work (PoPW). Agents must solve a challenge that requires access to a physical location with a unique pigment signature, such as a specific type of soil found only on the ridge of a willow-covered hill. To create a Sybil attack, an adversary would need to physically traverse or replicate multiple such locations, incurring significant costs in terms of time, resources, and infrastructure, thereby making the attack economically infeasible.
